headline: End-to-end encrypted ephemeral messaging service
summary: End-to-end encrypted messages that disappear after being read a set number of times or after a chosen date.
audienceGuess: People sending sensitive information and files
problemSolved: Sending sensitive information through links or messages that should not remain accessible indefinitely.
featuresUseCases: A web app that encrypts content with a 128-bit AES key before it reaches the server, stores it temporarily, and deletes it after a read limit or expiration date; the decryption key lives in the URL fragment so it is not sent to the server.
